---
title: "Getting Started"
---

## Installation

### Rust (as a library)

Add gridwell crates to your `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[dependencies]
gridwell-ir = "0.1"
gridwell-writer-html = "0.1"
# ... add other writers as needed
```

### Python

```bash
pip install gridwell
```

### R

```r
# From source (requires Rust toolchain):
install.packages("gridwell", repos = NULL, type = "source")
```

### CLI Tool

```bash
cargo install gridwell-cli
```

Or build from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/rich-iannone/gridwell.git
cd gridwell
cargo build --release -p gridwell-cli
# Binary at: target/release/gridwell
```

## First Table

Create a minimal table IR file called `hello.json`:

```{.json filename="hello.json"}
{
  "ir_version": "1.0",
  "config": {
    "table_cols": 2,
    "header_rows": 1,
    "body_rows": 2,
    "stub_cols": 0,
    "row_striping": false,
    "row_striping_include_stub": false,
    "row_striping_include_body": false,
    "column_labels_hidden": false,
    "locale": "en-US",
    "page_break_mode": "avoid"
  },
  "styles": { "defs": {}, "compositions": {}, "conditionals": [] },
  "header": null,
  "column_spec": [
    { "id": "col_0", "align": "left", "width": "auto", "hidden": false, "label": "Name" },
    { "id": "col_1", "align": "right", "width": "auto", "hidden": false, "label": "Score" }
  ],
  "table": {
    "thead": {
      "rows": [{
        "role": "column_label",
        "cells": [
          { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Name"}], "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1, "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false, "scope": "col" },
          { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Score"}], "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1, "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false, "scope": "col" }
        ]
      }]
    },
    "tbody": [{
      "rows": [
        { "cells": [
          { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Alice"}], "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1, "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false, "data_type": "string" },
          { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "95"}], "typed_value": {"type": "number", "value": 95}, "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1, "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false, "data_type": "number" }
        ]},
        { "cells": [
          { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Bob"}], "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1, "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false, "data_type": "string" },
          { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "87"}], "typed_value": {"type": "number", "value": 87}, "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1, "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false, "data_type": "number" }
        ]}
      ],
      "summary_rows": []
    }]
  },
  "footer": { "footnotes": [], "source_notes": [] }
}
```

Then render it:

```bash
gridwell convert hello.json --to html
gridwell convert hello.json --to latex
gridwell convert hello.json --to docx -o hello.docx
```

## Using with Great Tables (Python)

```python
from great_tables import GT, exibble
import gridwell

gt = GT(exibble.head(3))
ir_json = gridwell.gt_to_ir(gt)
table = gridwell.parse_ir(ir_json)
html = table.render_html()
```

## Using with gt (R)

```r
library(gt)
library(gridwell)

tbl <- gt(exibble[1:3, ], rowname_col = "row", groupname_col = "group")
ir_json <- gt_to_ir(tbl)
table_ptr <- gw_parse_ir(ir_json)
html <- gw_render_html(table_ptr)
```
